```{r}
#conversion functions
convert_idas <- function(x) {
    case_when(
      x == "1 - not at all" ~ 1,
      x == "2 - a little bit" ~ 2,
      x == "3 - moderately" ~ 3,
      x == "4 - quite a bit" ~ 4,
      x == "5 - extremely" ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(x) # Convert numbers directly
    )
}

convert_sticsa <- function(x) {
    case_when(
      x == "Not at All" ~ 1,
      x == "A little" ~ 2,
      x == "Moderately" ~ 3,
      x == "Very much So" ~ 4,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(x) # Convert numbers directly
    )
  }

convert_ius <- function(x) {
    case_when(
      x == "1 - Not at all characteristic of me" ~ 1,
      x == "3 - Somewhat characteristic of me" ~ 3,
      x == "5 - Entirely characteristic of me" ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(x) # Convert numbers directly
    )
  }

convert_tics<- function(x) {
    case_when(
      x == "Never" ~ 1,
      x == "Rarely" ~ 2,
      x == "Sometimes" ~ 3,
      x == "Frequently" ~ 4,
      x == "Always" ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(x) # Convert numbers directly
    )
  }

convert_pswq<- function(x) {
    case_when(
      x == "1 - Not at all typical of me" ~ 1,
      x == "5 - Very typical of me" ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(x) # Convert numbers directly
    )
}

convert_ctq<- function(x) {
    case_when(
      x == "Never True" ~ 1,
      x == "Rarely True" ~ 2,
      x == "Sometimes True" ~ 3,
      x == "Often True" ~ 4,
      x == "Very Often True" ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(x) # Convert numbers directly
    )
}

convert_cape<- function(x) {
    case_when(
      x == 'Never (If you ticked "never", please go to next question)' ~ 1,
      x == "Not distressed" ~ 1,
      x == "Sometimes" ~ 2,
      x == "A bit distressed" ~ 2,
      x == "Often" ~ 3,
      x == "Quite distressed" ~ 3,
      x == "Nearly always" ~ 4,
      x == "Very distressed" ~ 4,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(x) # Convert numbers directly
    )
  }
```

#infrequency filter
```{r}
xx_cols <- grep("XX", names(srvey), value = TRUE) 
df_infreq <- srvey %>% select(PROLIFICID, all_of(xx_cols))

# List of conversion functions
conversion_functions <- list(
  "STICSA" = convert_sticsa,
  "CAPE" = convert_cape,
  "TICS" = convert_tics,
  "CTQ" = convert_ctq,
  "IDAS" = convert_idas,
  "PSWQ" = convert_pswq,
  "IOU" = convert_ius
)

# Apply the correct conversion function to each column based on its name
df_infreq <- df_infreq %>%
  mutate(across(
    .cols = everything(), 
    .fns = ~ {
      col_name <- cur_column()
      matching_function <- NULL  # Default to no function
      
      for (prefix in names(conversion_functions)) {
        if (grepl(prefix, col_name, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
          matching_function <- conversion_functions[[prefix]]
          break
        }
      }
      
      if (!is.null(matching_function)) {
        matching_function(.)
      } else {
        .
      }
    }
  ))

df_infreq
df_pass = df_infreq
srvey_checks <- srvey
srvey <- srvey %>% select(-all_of(xx_cols))

df_pass$STICSA.XX4. <- ifelse(
  is.na(df_pass$STICSA.XX4.), "FAILED",
  ifelse(df_pass$STICSA.XX4. >= 3, "PASSED", "FAILED")
) #accepted response: "Moderately", "Very much so". 

df_pass$TICS.XX1. <- ifelse(
  is.na(df_pass$TICS.XX1.), "FAILED",
  ifelse(df_pass$TICS.XX1. >= 4, "PASSED", "FAILED")
) #accepted response: "Frequently", "Always"

df_pass$CAPE01.XX3..1. <- ifelse(
  is.na(df_pass$CAPE01.XX3..1.), "FAILED",
  ifelse(df_pass$CAPE01.XX3..1. <= 2, "PASSED", "FAILED")
) #accepted response: "Never", "Sometimes"

df_pass$CTQ.XX2. <- ifelse(
  is.na(df_pass$CTQ.XX2.), "FAILED",
  ifelse(df_pass$CTQ.XX2. >= 4, "PASSED", "FAILED")
) #accepted response: "Often true", "Very often true"

df_pass$IDAS.XX6. <- ifelse(
  is.na(df_pass$IDAS.XX6), "PASSED",
  ifelse(df_pass$IDAS.XX6. <= 2, "PASSED", "FAILED")
)

df_pass$PSWQ.XX7. <- ifelse(
  is.na(df_pass$PSWQ.XX7), "PASSED",
  ifelse(df_pass$PSWQ.XX7 > 4, "PASSED", "FAILED")
)

df_pass$IOU.XX5. <- ifelse(
  is.na(df_pass$IOU.XX5), "PASSED",
  ifelse(df_pass$IOU.XX5 <= 2, "PASSED", "FAILED")
)


df_pass

cols_to_check <- c("STICSA.XX4.", "TICS.XX1.", "CAPE01.XX3..1.", "CTQ.XX2.", "IOU.XX5.", "PSWQ.XX7.", "IDAS.XX6.")

# Count PASSED and FAILED per row
df_pass$N_PASSED <- apply(df_pass[cols_to_check], 1, function(x) sum(x == "PASSED"))
df_pass$N_FAILED <- apply(df_pass[cols_to_check], 1, function(x) sum(x == "FAILED"))


print(df_pass)
# here we expect: TICS 4, CTQ 5, Cape 1, STICSA 4

df_pass$checks = ifelse(df_pass$N_FAILED >2, 0, 1)

dfchecks = df_pass[,c("PROLIFICID", "checks")]
table(dfchecks$checks)
```

```{r}
questionnaires <- c("STICSA", "IOU", "IDAS", "TICS", "CAPE01", "CTQ", "PSWQ")

for (q_prefix in questionnaires) {
  
  q_cols <- grep(paste0("^", q_prefix), names(srvey), value = TRUE)
  df_subset <- srvey %>%
    select(id, PROLIFICID, all_of(q_cols))
  
  assign(paste0("df_", tolower(q_prefix)), df_subset)
}

#subscales
ctq_phisicalabuse <- c("CTQ.ctq9.","CTQ.ctq11.","CTQ.ctq12.","CTQ.ctq15.","CTQ.ctq17.")
ctq_emotionalabuse <- c("CTQ.ctq3.","CTQ.ctq8.","CTQ.ctq14.","CTQ.ctq18.","CTQ.ctq22.")
ctq_sexualabuse <- c("CTQ.ctq20.","CTQ.ctq21.","CTQ.ctq23.","CTQ.ctq24.","CTQ.ctq27.")
ctq_phisicalnegelect <- c("CTQ.ctq1.","CTQ.ctq2.","CTQ.ctq4.","CTQ.ctq6.","CTQ.ctq26.")
ctq_emotionalneglect <- c("CTQ.ctq5.","CTQ.ctq7.","CTQ.ctq13.","CTQ.ctq19.","CTQ.ctq28.")


score_ctq <- df_ctq %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # Total score: sum all items except id and PROLIFICID
    ctq_score = sum(c_across(-c(id, PROLIFICID)), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Subscale sums
    ctq_phisicalabuse     = sum(c_across(all_of(ctq_phisicalabuse)), na.rm = TRUE),
    ctq_emotionalabuse    = sum(c_across(all_of(ctq_emotionalabuse)), na.rm = TRUE),
    ctq_sexualabuse       = sum(c_across(all_of(ctq_sexualabuse)), na.rm = TRUE),
    ctq_phisicalnegelect  = sum(c_across(all_of(ctq_phisicalnegelect)), na.rm = TRUE),
    ctq_emotionalneglect  = sum(c_across(all_of(ctq_emotionalneglect)), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(questionnaire = "CTQ") %>%
  select(id, PROLIFICID, ctq_score, ctq_phisicalabuse, ctq_emotionalabuse, 
         ctq_sexualabuse, ctq_phisicalnegelect, ctq_emotionalneglect)
```

#make df for factor analysis
```{r}
#srvey <- read.csv(survey_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
xx_cols <- grep("XX", names(srvey), value = TRUE) 
conversion_functions <- list(
  "STICSA" = convert_sticsa,
  "CAPE" = convert_cape,
  "TICS" = convert_tics,
  "CTQ" = convert_ctq,
  "IDAS" = convert_idas,
  "PSWQ" = convert_pswq,
  "IOU" = convert_ius
)

excluded_cols <- unique(c(
  xx_cols,
  "id", "submitdate", "lastpage", "startlanguage", "seed", "startdate", "datestamp", "refurl","interviewtime","groupTime103898","PROLIFICIDTime", "groupTime109264","STICSATime","groupTime103894","IOUTime","groupTime104622","IDASTime","groupTime105103","TICSTime","groupTime105108","CAPE01Time","groupTime104657","CTQTime","groupTime109282","PSWQTime"
))


cols_to_convert <- setdiff(names(srvey), excluded_cols)

# Apply conversion functions
converted_part <- srvey %>%
  select(all_of(cols_to_convert)) %>%
  mutate(across(
    everything(),
    ~ {
      col_name <- cur_column()
      matching_function <- NULL
      
      for (prefix in names(conversion_functions)) {
        if (grepl(prefix, col_name, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
          matching_function <- conversion_functions[[prefix]]
          break
        }
      }
      
      if (!is.null(matching_function)) {
        matching_function(.)
      } else {
        .
      }
    }
  ))


final_df <- bind_cols(
  srvey %>% select(all_of(excluded_cols)),
  converted_part
)

final_df <- final_df %>%
  select(-all_of(excluded_cols))
```
